title: Men's Sandals – Convertible for Sports & Beach
descriptionHtml:
Comfortable sandals for the whole summer

It's nice not to have to lace up shoes on warm days. But many sandals are both uncomfortable and slippery when they get wet.

Two styles in one pair

These sandals can be worn two ways and suit both the beach and everyday wear. The sole gives good grip and the material is both light and comfortable against the foot.

Features

  • Convertible design – two styles in one pair
  • Non-slip sole with good grip
  • Lightweight, comfortable material
  • Good for the beach, camping and everyday
  • Easy to rinse clean

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
